full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white documentary-style photograph looks along a wet, snow-edged industrial road disappearing into fog. The foreground is dark and uneven, with shallow puddles reflecting a pale sky and slushy tire tracks drawing long converging lines toward the center distance. Snow lies in thin irregular bands on either side of the road and across the ground beside the rail lines on the right. A small lone person walks away near the center, appearing as a compact dark silhouette beneath the enormous light sky. On the left, a tall utility pole dominates the near foreground, its stacked crossbars and many fine wires reaching upward and then repeating as smaller poles toward the vanishing point. Low winter brush occupies the left roadside. Across the middle distance on the right, dark factory buildings and several chimneys rise through mist; one thick plume of gray smoke expands above them and spreads leftward into the clouded air. A low pitched-roof structure sits nearer the right edge, while bright points of distant light glimmer around the industrial yard. The road and parallel tracks become less distinct as they recede, merging into the pale fog rather than ending in a sharp horizon. Diffuse overcast light comes from the bright sky, leaving the foreground in heavy charcoal tones while snow and fog remain silvery; the small lights add local highlights without changing the cold overall illumination. Grain, softened distance, and glossy puddle reflections make the image feel physically damp and chilled. The human figure, poles, and smoke remain legible through strong dark silhouettes, although finer buildings fade into haze. The overall composition balances a weighted black foreground against an expansive pale sky and uses converging ground lines to draw a quiet, solitary path through the industrial atmosphere.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形黑白纪实风格摄影沿一条湿滑、积雪镶边的工业道路望去，道路消失在雾中。前景深暗而不平，浅水洼映出苍白天空，泥雪中的车辙拉成长长的汇聚线，通向中央远处。薄而不规则的积雪带铺在路两侧和右方轨道旁的地面上。一名小小的孤身行人靠近中央向远处走去，在巨大的浅色天空下成为紧凑深色剪影。左侧一根高电线杆主导近景，层叠横担和许多细电线向上伸展，更多较小的电杆沿消失点方向重复。低矮冬季灌木占据左侧路边。中远景右方，深色厂房与几根烟囱从薄雾中升起；一大股灰烟在其上方扩散，并向左融入多云空气。靠近右画边有一座低矮斜屋顶建筑，工业场地附近闪着几点远处灯光。道路与平行铁轨随着后退而变得不清楚，融入苍白雾气，并没有在清晰地平线上结束。漫射阴天光来自明亮天空，使前景保持浓重炭色，雪和雾呈银灰色；小灯光只增加局部亮点，不改变整体冷光。颗粒、柔化的远景和光亮水洼倒影，让图像具有真实的潮湿寒冷感。行人、电杆和烟柱仍以强烈深色剪影可辨，较细小的建筑则退入雾中。整体构图以沉重黑色前景平衡宽阔浅色天空，并用汇聚的地面线引出穿过工业空气的安静孤独路径。
style_prompt_en: The monochrome photograph combines strong near-black foreground weight with pale, fog-softened distance. Fine grain and damp reflective patches break up the dark surface, while long converging marks create a clear pull through otherwise low-contrast space. Repeated thin uprights and crosslines establish a measured rhythm, becoming smaller and fainter as they recede. Broad gray atmospheric masses have soft boundaries, but a few compact silhouettes stay distinct enough to fix scale. Diffuse sky light brightens haze and light ground areas without hard cast shadows; occasional small bright points punctuate the mist. The image feels documentary and tactile, using wet sheen, grain, and tonal recession to create quiet depth within a restrained black-to-silver range.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅黑白摄影把浓重的近黑色前景与被雾柔化的浅色远处结合。细颗粒和潮湿反光斑打散深色表面，长而汇聚的痕迹在其余低反差空间中形成清楚牵引。重复的细直线和横线建立有节制的节奏，随着后退变得更小、更淡。宽阔灰色空气团边界柔和，但少数紧凑剪影仍足够分明，可以固定尺度。漫射天光照亮雾气与浅色地面，没有生硬投影；偶尔的小亮点点破薄雾。图像具有纪实感和可触性，以湿亮表面、颗粒和明度退远，在克制的黑至银色范围中建立安静纵深。
theme_en: A lone figure on a snowy industrial road with smoke and utility poles receding into fog
theme_zh: 孤身人物走在积雪工业道路上，烟柱与电线杆隐入雾中
name: David Plowden
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
